- When sentiment is strongly positive (≥ 0.67) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast slightly.
- When sentiment is strongly negative (≤ -0.33) in recent days, model tends to underestimate prices; increase forecast slightly.
- Model often overshoots after sharp upward sentiment spikes; apply a 1–2 day lag correction downward.
- Model frequently overreacts to recent price spikes, especially in early forecast horizon; dampen peak predictions.
- Mean reversion bias: if forecast is > 1.5σ above recent 10-day average, reduce by 0.1–0.3 units.
- For 30-day horizon, model tends to be too optimistic in early days; apply downward bias of 0.5–1.0 units if sentiment is neutral or mildly positive.
- If sentiment history shows alternating bullish/bearish cycles, model often misaligns with cycle phase; adjust forecast to match sentiment trend direction.
